biological_claim: Immediate-Early peptide ICP47 (alpha47, 88 aa); high-affinity competitor that binds the cytosolic peptide-binding site of host TAP (transporter associated with antigen processing), blocking peptide translocation into the ER and preventing MHC class I antigen presentation.
